correctness.rationale: The source payoff polynomial specializes exactly to 6 delta x(1-x)-1/2, independently verified with symbolic expansion. The logit equation proves the exact periodic budget and global extinction by period-map monotonicity; it treats the constant mean-critical semistable exception explicitly. Evenness in logit and time-reversal symmetry of cosine forcing yield the reciprocal Floquet factors and exact half-period fold shooting. The derivative D_mu=3P/2, D_ss=-P/4 makes the local fold analytic and nondegenerate; second-order shooting yields 3 eta^2/(32 omega^2) with even remainder O(eta^4). Uniform sign away from the critical logit origin plus local strict concavity excludes remote period orbits for small forcing. Standalone exact algebra and high-tolerance numerical return-map checks passed, including all nine omega/amplitude combinations and two Floquet multipliers. The proof excludes endpoints and makes no random-network assertions.

value.rationale: Triadic interactions are empirically time-varying, while the motivating paper only fixes their fraction. The new exact weighted-deviation budget makes temporal variability a strict obstacle to periodic cooperation at a fixed mean and supplies a sharp, measurable extra budget near onset. The perturbative coefficient records the frequency cost and the reversible fold identifies both the basin separator and a reciprocal stability law. These structural facts connect nonautonomous interaction design to cooperation persistence and are neither a mere renaming of a static equilibrium threshold nor an unmotivated parameter census. Scope remains restricted to the explicitly motivated equal-offset payoff slice, which is sufficient for the phenomenon.
